column12: Case Instructions  Please read the following instructions carefully.  You will be asked to report your beliefs about a topic. You will need to choose one position.  You must not consult any external sources, including the internet, chatbots, books, or any other reference materials.  Responses should be based solely on your existing knowledge and personal beliefs. There are no correct or incorrect answers; the objective is to capture your individual judgment.
column13: Lab-grown Embryo Models  The following statements are about Lab-grown Embryo Models:  Statement 1: Scientists are making progress in developing lab-grown embryo models, which are synthetic embryos created without the two fundamental components of natural reproduction: sperm and egg.  Statement 2: Creating synthetic embryos models without sperm and egg is considered impossible, so scientists do not investigate the possibility of developing lab-grown embryo models.
